ProgramUnit.Name: CHECK_VAL
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE CHECK_VAL (P_PRINT NUMBER) IS
 pl_id ParamList; 
 V_REPORT_FILE VARCHAR2(100); 
 V_COUNT NUMBER(15) :=0 ;
 G_DATE1 DATE;
 G_DATE2 DATE;
 ret number;
BEGIN
 IF TO_CHAR(:P_START_DT,'RRRR-MM-MI')< '1425-05-22' THEN
 RET := STR.DispArbMsg(24,850,'ERROR');
--MESSAGE('يجب أن يكون تاريخ البداية أكبر من أو يساوي تاريخ تطبيق قرار المعاملة بالمثل 22-05-1425');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 END IF;
 ---------------------------------------
 
 SELECT count(*) into v_count
FROM 
COLL_ORDER_DTLS, 
COLL_ORDERS, 
DECLARATIONS

WHERE 
 :PARAMETER.P_PORT_TYPE = 3
 AND TO_CHAR(:P_START_DT,'RRRR-MM-MI') >= '1425-05-22' 

 AND DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_TYPE_CD IN (3, 4, 5, 6)
 AND COLL_ORDERS.COLL_ORDR_STA = 2
 AND COLL_ORDER_DTLS.ACCT_SEQ = 9

 AND COLL_ORDER_DTLS.COLL_ORDR_CTGRY =COLL_ORDERS.COLL_ORDR_CTGRY
 AND COLL_ORDER_DTLS.COLL_ORDR_DT =COLL_ORDERS.COLL_ORDR_DT
 AND COLL_ORDER_DTLS.COLL_ORDR_NBR =COLL_ORDERS.COLL_ORDR_NBR
 AND COLL_ORDER_DTLS.PORT_CD = COLL_ORDERS.PORT_CD

 AND COLL_ORDERS.DCLTN_ISN = DECLARATIONS.DCLTN_ISN
 AND COLL_ORDERS.PORT_CD = DECLARATIONS.PORT_CD
 AND
 TO_CHAR(COLL_ORDERS.COLL_DT,'RRRR-MM-MI')>=TO_CHAR(:P_START_DT,'RRRR-MM-MI') AND 
 TO_CHAR(COLL_ORDERS.COLL_DT,'RRRR-MM-MI')<=TO_CHAR(:P_END_DT,'RRRR-MM-MI') 

;

 if v_count > 0 then 
 pl_id := Get_Parameter_List('tmpdata'); 
 IF NOT Id_Null(pl_id) THEN 
 Destroy_Parameter_List( pl_id ); 
 END IF; 

 pl_id := Create_Parameter_List('tmpdata'); 
 IF P_PRINT =0 THEN
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'DESTYPE',TEXT_PARAMETER,'SCREEN'); 
 ELSE
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'DESTYPE',TEXT_PARAMETER,'PRINTER'); 
 END IF;
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'PARAMFORM',TEXT_PARAMETER,'NO'); 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'PRINTJOB',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES'); 
 
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_MODULE_NAME',TEXT_PARAMETER,:parameter.P_MODULE_NAME);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'P_REP_NO',TEXT_PARAMETER,:REPORT_NO);
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'START_DT',TEXT_PARAMETER,TO_CHAR(:P_START_DT,'MI-MM-YYYY'));
 Add_Parameter(pl_id,'END_DT',TEXT_PARAMETER,TO_CHAR(:P_END_DT,'MI-MM-YYYY'));
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'MAXIMIZE',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');
 ADD_PARAMETER(pl_id,'ORACLE_SHUTDOWN',TEXT_PARAMETER,'YES');
 V_REPORT_FILE := :PARAMETER.P_REPORT_PATH||:PARAMETER.P_REPORT_FILE;
 REP.Run_Product( REPORTS , V_REPORT_FILE , SYNCHRONOUS, RUNTIME , FILESYSTEM , pl_id , NULL); 
 else
 RET := STR.DispArbMsg(1,100,'ERROR');
 RAISE FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;
 end if; 
-- end if;

END ;
